setlist_extra.title: That's It For The Other One

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **That's It For The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer says track 16 is titled wrongly and should read Cryptical Envelopment into The Other One; the closing piece should be a Castle reference [6]

## Setlist highlights

- **Cryptical Envelopment**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [15]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Turn On Your Lovelight [15]

## The recordings

- **dead2015-11-28** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 186 min; rated 4.25/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer, who attended the show, calls this a very good recording; Sounds intimate, like a well-treated club, with very fast decay; Uploader says the sound mix was very good [1][6][10]
- **dc2015-11-28.Dead_and_Company2015-11-28.aud.sp-cmc-25.mullen.134753.flac16**: audience recording; 18 songs; 186 min; rated 4.5/5 by 8 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer rates it among the best-sounding Dead & Company recordings, and thinks it has post-production work [12]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says John and Oteil add energy, with John's guitar work evoking Jerry's playing in his own style [14]
- Saturday night crowd was enthusiastic and well behaved near the recorder [1]
- Reviewer finds it better than other Dead & Company recordings they have heard, except the 11/07 AMX one [12]
- Reviewer thinks it is in the running for best of the tour, and among the best Dead shows they have seen in 25 years [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **dead2015-11-28**: Recorded and transferred by Robert Mullen: Boost Box with 69Hz bass roll-off, Sony PCM-M10 at 44.1kHz/16-bit, FLAC level 8 [1]
- **dc2015-11-28.Dead_and_Company2015-11-28.aud.sp-cmc-25.mullen.134753.flac16**: taped by Robert Mullen/lvrwm; transferred by Robert Mullen/lvrwm; source: Audience Master [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Worthpoint: [Dead & Company Poster MGM Grand Las Vegas November 27/28 2015 Grateful Dead | #1800785933](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/dead-company-poster-mgm-grand-las-1800785933) [16]
